key: Hey, you, I hope your body's ready for this battle!
en: Hey, you, I hope your body's ready for this battle!
ja: おい　このバトルに　体の準備は　できてるか?

key: It seems that my body wasn't ready enough...
en: It seems that my body wasn't ready enough...
ja: サイモン: どうやら　僕の体の準備は　足りなかったようだ……

key: I'm not ready anymore.
en: I'm not ready anymore.
ja: もう　準備なんて　できてない。

key: HARDY: Yo, there you are!
en: HARDY: Yo, there you are!
ja: ハーディ: よう　やっと　来たか!

key: So there's definitely something weird here. You feel this glass?
en: So there's definitely something weird here. You feel this glass?
ja: ここ　絶対　何か　変だぜ。このガラス　感じるか?

key: If it's warm enough to melt the snow, there's gotta be somethin' down there.
en: If it's warm enough to melt the snow, there's gotta be somethin' down there.
ja: 雪を　溶かせるほど　暖かいってことは　下に　何かが　あるに違いねえ。

key: Still, I can't quite make out whatever's goin' on.
en: Still, I can't quite make out whatever's goin' on.
ja: とはいえ　何が　起きてんのか　いまいち　つかめねえな。

key: I remember some kind of rumor about an old glass factory north of Agate, but I didn't think much of it.
en: I remember some kind of rumor about an old glass factory north of Agate, but I didn't think much of it.
ja: アゲートの北に　古いガラス工場が　あったって　うわさは　聞いたことが　あったが　大して　気にも　してなかった。

key: But that thing was supposed to have shut down ages ago.
en: But that thing was supposed to have shut down ages ago.
ja: でも　あれ　もうとっくの昔に　閉鎖されてる　はずなんだ。

key: So that makes this capital shady.
en: So that makes this capital shady.
ja: だから　これ　かなり　怪しいんだよ。

key: I wanted to wait for you before blowin' in there myself,
en: I wanted to wait for you before blowin' in there myself,
ja: 自分だけで　突っ込む前に　お前を　待とうと　思ってな

key: But I'd wager some solid coin that that building's gotta have a way down.
en: But I'd wager some solid coin that that building's gotta have a way down.
ja: でも　あの建物に　下へ　続く道が　あるってのに　結構な金を　賭けてもいいぜ。

key: How 'bout you?
en: How 'bout you?
ja: お前は　どうだ?

key: 2k says there's an entrance in there; you gonna say there ain't?
en: 2k says there's an entrance in there; you gonna say there ain't?
ja: $2000　賭けて　あそこに　入り口が　あるって言うぜ。お前は　ないって　言うのか?

key: HARDY: Rock on. It's a bet.
en: HARDY: Rock on. It's a bet.
ja: ハーディ: よし。それで　賭けだ。

key: HARDY: I wouldn't either.
en: HARDY: I wouldn't either.
ja: ハーディ: おれも　同じ意見だ。

key: Let's check it out.
en: Let's check it out.
ja: 確かめてみよう。

key: HARDY: Oi, \PN, help me move this.
en: HARDY: Oi, \PN, help me move this.
ja: ハーディ: おい\PN　これ　動かすの　手伝ってくれ。

key: I dunno why this junk's here, but maybe there's somethin' to it.
en: I dunno why this junk's here, but maybe there's somethin' to it.
ja: なんで　こんながらくたが　ここに　あるのか　わかんねえが　何か　あるのかもな。

key: Here, you take that side.
en: Here, you take that side.
ja: ほら　そっち側　持ってくれ。

key: HARDY: You take the other side.
en: HARDY: You take the other side.
ja: ハーディ: お前は　反対側を　持ってくれ。

key: Let's just get this junk outta the way, yea?
en: Let's just get this junk outta the way, yea?
ja: とにかく　このがらくたを　どかそうぜ　いいな?

key: HARDY: Aite, let's do this. On three...
en: HARDY: Aite, let's do this. On three...
ja: ハーディ: よし　やるぞ。3で……

key: One...
en: One...

key: Two...
en: Two...

key: Heave,
en: Heave,
ja: せーの

key: Ho!
en: Ho!
ja: よいしょ!

key: HARDY: Mm.
en: HARDY: Mm.
ja: ハーディ: うーん。

key: I may not have been there for it all, but even I know that's bad news, mate.
en: I may not have been there for it all, but even I know that's bad news, mate.
ja: おれも　全部　見てたわけじゃ　ねえが　それでも　こいつは　やばそうだって　わかるぜ　相棒。

key: Still ain't an entrance though. I was hopin'.
en: Still ain't an entrance though. I was hopin'.
ja: でも　まだ　入り口じゃ　ねえな。期待してたんだが。

key: Well, deal's a deal.
en: Well, deal's a deal.
ja: まあ　約束は　約束だ。

key: Hardy forked over $2000!
en: Hardy forked over $2000!
ja: ハーディは　$2000を　支払った!

key: HARDY: Aite, only one thing left to do then.
en: HARDY: Aite, only one thing left to do then.
ja: ハーディ: よし　あとは　一つしか　やることが　ねえな。

key: If we can't find an entrance...
en: If we can't find an entrance...
ja: 入り口が　見つからねえなら……

key: Well, you know the drill.
en: Well, you know the drill.
ja: まあ　やることは　わかってるだろ。

key: HARDY: Time to kick some glass!
en: HARDY: Time to kick some glass!
ja: ハーディ: ガラスを　蹴っ飛ばす　時間だ!

key: Gigalith, rock their worlds! Earthquake!
en: Gigalith, rock their worlds! Earthquake!
ja: ギガイアス　揺らしてやれ! じしん!

key: HARDY: Are you kiddin' me?
en: HARDY: Are you kiddin' me?
ja: ハーディ: マジかよ?

key: What the heck is this stuff made of?
en: What the heck is this stuff made of?
ja: こいつ　一体　何で　できてんだ?

key: Gigalith ain' no weakling. I expected this whole place to blow right out.
en: Gigalith ain' no weakling. I expected this whole place to blow right out.
ja: ギガイアスは　弱っちくねえ。この場所　まるごと　吹っ飛ぶと　思ってたのに。

key: HARDY: Still, I thought I heard something over there.
en: HARDY: Still, I thought I heard something over there.
ja: ハーディ: それでも　あっちで　何か　聞こえた気が　するな。

key: Let's give it a look!
en: Let's give it a look!
ja: 見に行こうぜ!

key: HARDY: You really are joshin' me right now, huh.
en: HARDY: You really are joshin' me right now, huh.
ja: ハーディ: マジで　からかってんのか。

key: Outta this whole big plain of glass, it's this little spot, all the way out here, that gives?
en: Outta this whole big plain of glass, it's this little spot, all the way out here, that gives?
ja: こんだけ　でかいガラスの平原の中で　こんな遠くの　小さな一角だけが　崩れるのかよ?

key: And there just happens to be a ladder down, too.
en: And there just happens to be a ladder down, too.
ja: しかも　都合よく　下に　降りるはしごまで　あるときた。

key: Tellin' ya, it's capital shade.
en: Tellin' ya, it's capital shade.
ja: 言っとくが　かなり　うさんくせえ。

key: And not the Leader, either.
en: And not the Leader, either.
ja: べつに　シェイドの　ことを　言ってるんじゃ　ねえぜ。

key: Well, we didn't come this far just to stop here.
en: Well, we didn't come this far just to stop here.
ja: まあ　ここまで　来て　止まるために　来たわけじゃ　ねえ。

key: Let's do this.
en: Let's do this.
ja: やろうぜ。

key: I'll go ahead. Careful you don't get cut on the glass.
en: I'll go ahead. Careful you don't get cut on the glass.
ja: 先に　行くぜ。ガラスで　切らないように　気をつけろよ。

key: This could get messy.
en: This could get messy.
ja: 厄介なことに　なるかもな。

key: GARDEVOIR: Well? How is it?
en: GARDEVOIR: Well? How is it?
ja: サーナイト: あら? どうかしら?

key: RADOMUS: It's an adventure.
en: RADOMUS: It's an adventure.
ja: ラドマス: 冒険だよ。

key: An elevator with cut cable frosting and sprinkles of glass all over it.
en: An elevator with cut cable frosting and sprinkles of glass all over it.
ja: 切れたケーブルの糖衣と　ガラスの散りばめが　かかった　エレベーターだ。

key: LUNA: I believe I'll wait for supper.
en: LUNA: I believe I'll wait for supper.
ja: ルナ: わたくしは　夕食まで　待つことに　いたします。

key: RADOMUS: Indeed. One would need to be mad to climb down through this.
en: RADOMUS: Indeed. One would need to be mad to climb down through this.
ja: ラドマス: 確かに。これを　降りるなんて　狂気の沙汰だろうな。

key: GARDEVOIR: So, I take it you're going immediately~?
en: GARDEVOIR: So, I take it you're going immediately~?
ja: サーナイト: つまり　すぐに　行くってこと　なのね~?

key: RADOMUS: I just might.
en: RADOMUS: I just might.
ja: ラドマス: もしかしたらね。

key: ???: ...Gardevoir?
en: ???: ...Gardevoir?
ja: ???: ……サーナイト?

key: SERRA: Luna too? What are you doing here?
en: SERRA: Luna too? What are you doing here?
ja: セラ: ルナも? あなたたち　ここで　何を　してるの?

key: LUNA: How do you do, Mother?
en: LUNA: How do you do, Mother?
ja: ルナ: ごきげんよう　お母様。

key: SERRA: And that means that person must be...
en: SERRA: And that means that person must be...
ja: セラ: ということは　あの人は　つまり……

key: SERRA: ...Based on the strange hat, Radomus.
en: SERRA: ...Based on the strange hat, Radomus.
ja: セラ: ……その奇妙な帽子から　察するに　ラドマスね。

key: RADOMUS: Radomus M. Vanhanen, to be precise.
en: RADOMUS: Radomus M. Vanhanen, to be precise.
ja: ラドマス: 正確には　ラドマス・M・ヴァンハネンだ。

key: My hat resents your words, but I, on the other hand, am honored to make your acquaintance.
en: My hat resents your words, but I, on the other hand, am honored to make your acquaintance.
ja: この帽子は　君の言葉に　不満を　抱いているだろうが　私自身は　あなたと　知り合えて　光栄に思う。

key: I have heard much about you, madam.
en: I have heard much about you, madam.
ja: あなたのことは　いろいろと　伺っております　奥様。

key: SERRA: Likewise...
en: SERRA: Likewise...
ja: セラ: こちらこそ……

key: GARDEVOIR: Luna, dear, are you unwell?
en: GARDEVOIR: Luna, dear, are you unwell?
ja: サーナイト: ルナ　あなた　具合でも　悪いの?

key: Are you crying?
en: Are you crying?
ja: 泣いてるの?

key: LUNA: I--
en: LUNA: I--
ja: ルナ: わたくし――

key: I am perfectly fine; there is no need to worry about me.
en: I am perfectly fine; there is no need to worry about me.
ja: まったく　問題　ありません。心配は　ご無用です。

key: I am just very--
en: I am just very--
ja: ただ　とても――

key: Happy.
en: Happy.
ja: うれしいのです。

key: I am happy to have you both back.
en: I am happy to have you both back.
ja: お二人が　戻ってきてくれて　うれしいのです。

key: SERRA: Right...
en: SERRA: Right...
ja: セラ: そう……

key: RADOMUS: So, Miss Voclain, what brings you to these remote parts?
en: RADOMUS: So, Miss Voclain, what brings you to these remote parts?
ja: ラドマス: ところで　ヴォクラン嬢　こんなへんぴな場所に　何用かな?

key: SERRA: Parenting.
en: SERRA: Parenting.
ja: セラ: 親としての務めよ。

key: RADOMUS: Well, it seems you've come to the right place.
en: RADOMUS: Well, it seems you've come to the right place.
ja: ラドマス: それなら　どうやら　いい場所に　来たようだ。

key: SERRA: I didn't mean--
en: SERRA: I didn't mean--
ja: セラ: そういう意味じゃ――

key: I suppose so.
en: I suppose so.
ja: そうかも　しれないわね。

key: GARDEVOIR: And now we finally have the whole family together~
en: GARDEVOIR: And now we finally have the whole family together~
ja: サーナイト: これで　やっと　家族　全員　そろったわね~

key: What a wonderful, but shocking, turn of events!
en: What a wonderful, but shocking, turn of events!
ja: なんて　素晴らしくて　衝撃的な　展開かしら!

key: RADOMUS: ...
en: RADOMUS: ...
ja: ラドマス: ……

key: Miss Voclain, would I be right in deducing that this magnificent Gardevoir was the one who directed you to this place?
en: Miss Voclain, would I be right in deducing that this magnificent Gardevoir was the one who directed you to this place?
ja: ヴォクラン嬢　この見事なサーナイトが　あなたを　ここへ　導いたと　推測しても　間違いないだろうか?

key: GARDEVOIR: What?! Preposterous!
en: GARDEVOIR: What?! Preposterous!
ja: サーナイト: え?! とんでもないわ!

key: SERRA: You would.
en: SERRA: You would.
ja: セラ: あなたなら　やりそうね。

key: GARDEVOIR: The slander!
en: GARDEVOIR: The slander!
ja: サーナイト: なんて　中傷なの!

key: LUNA: Gardevoir, you were the one who arranged this rendezvous?
en: LUNA: Gardevoir, you were the one who arranged this rendezvous?
ja: ルナ: サーナイト　この再会を　仕組んだのは　あなただったのですか?

key: GARDEVOIR: Why, the audacity to imply such a thing--
en: GARDEVOIR: Why, the audacity to imply such a thing--
ja: サーナイト: まあ　そんなことを　ほのめかすなんて　図々しいわ――

key: I could faint on the very spot!
en: I could faint on the very spot!
ja: その場で　卒倒しても　おかしくないわ!

key: LUNA: Gardevoir.
en: LUNA: Gardevoir.
ja: ルナ: サーナイト。

key: GARDEVOIR: La la la, fainting over here~
en: GARDEVOIR: La la la, fainting over here~
ja: サーナイト: らーらーらー　こちらで　卒倒中です~

key: LUNA: Thank you.
en: LUNA: Thank you.
ja: ルナ: ありがとう。

key: Truly.
en: Truly.
ja: 本当に。

key: RADOMUS: Madam?
en: RADOMUS: Madam?
ja: ラドマス: 奥様?

key: SERRA: I need to find my son.
en: SERRA: I need to find my son.
ja: セラ: わたくし　息子を　見つけないと　いけないの。

key: RADOMUS: And, should he be here, we shall.
en: RADOMUS: And, should he be here, we shall.
ja: ラドマス: もし　彼が　ここに　いるなら　共に　見つけよう。

key: Do you not think it wise to go together?
en: Do you not think it wise to go together?
ja: 一緒に　行くのが　賢明だとは　思わないかい?

key: SERRA: I know better than to count on others staying.
en: SERRA: I know better than to count on others staying.
ja: セラ: 他人を　あてに　し続けるほど　わたくしは　愚かじゃ　ないわ。

key: LUNA: Mother?
en: LUNA: Mother?
ja: ルナ: お母様?

key: RADOMUS: And even if it be unwise, do you not think it kind?
en: RADOMUS: And even if it be unwise, do you not think it kind?
ja: ラドマス: たとえ　賢明でなくとも　優しさだとは　思わないかい?

key: SERRA: ...
en: SERRA: ...
ja: セラ: ……

key: Fine, I understand.
en: Fine, I understand.
ja: わかったわ　いいでしょう。

key: I'll go with you all.
en: I'll go with you all.
ja: みんなと　一緒に　行くわ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Fantastic~! Serra joined the party!
en: GARDEVOIR: Fantastic~! Serra joined the party!
ja: サーナイト: 素晴らしいわ~! セラが　仲間に　加わったわね!

key: LUNA: Although I do not wish to be an inconvenience, I very much appreciate it.
en: LUNA: Although I do not wish to be an inconvenience, I very much appreciate it.
ja: ルナ: ご迷惑を　おかけしたくは　ありませんが　とても　ありがたく　思います。

key: SERRA: What have I gotten myself into now...
en: SERRA: What have I gotten myself into now...
ja: セラ: わたくし　一体　何に　巻き込まれてるのかしら……

key: RADOMUS: Something messy.
en: RADOMUS: Something messy.
ja: ラドマス: 厄介なことにね。

key: Something wonderful.
en: Something wonderful.
ja: そして　素晴らしいことにも。

key: SERRA: At least take me out to dinner before that.
en: SERRA: At least take me out to dinner before that.
ja: セラ: その前に　せめて　夕食にでも　連れて行ってちょうだい。

key: SERRA: Though I suppose you might have a certain amount of charm, were it not for the goofy hat.
en: SERRA: Though I suppose you might have a certain amount of charm, were it not for the goofy hat.
ja: セラ: まあ　あの間抜けな帽子さえ　なければ　あなたにも　多少は　魅力が　あるのかも　しれないけど。

key: GARDEVOIR: Now you listen here!
en: GARDEVOIR: Now you listen here!
ja: サーナイト: ちょっと　聞きなさいよ!

key: I may have set you two up, but don't forget that Master belongs to me!
en: I may have set you two up, but don't forget that Master belongs to me!
ja: 確かに　お二人を　くっつけたのは　わたくしかも　しれないけど　マスターは　わたくしのものだって　忘れないでね!

key: RADOMUS: Madam, I assure you; were it not for the goofy hats, I would have nothing at all.
en: RADOMUS: Madam, I assure you; were it not for the goofy hats, I would have nothing at all.
ja: ラドマス: 奥様　保証しよう。あの間抜けな帽子が　なければ　私には　何も　残らないのだから。

key: SERRA: You don't say.
en: SERRA: You don't say.
ja: セラ: あら　そうなの。

key: Then I suppose you've got a step over me after all.
en: Then I suppose you've got a step over me after all.
ja: だったら　やっぱり　あなたの方が　一枚　上手ってことね。

key: LUNA: Mother, please do not say things like that now.
en: LUNA: Mother, please do not say things like that now.
ja: ルナ: お母様　今は　そのようなことを　おっしゃらないでください。

key: I know very well how much loss you've felt throughout your life.
en: I know very well how much loss you've felt throughout your life.
ja: お母様が　これまでの人生で　どれほどの喪失を　感じてこられたか　わたくし　よく　わかっています。

key: But unless it can somehow be changed,
en: But unless it can somehow be changed,
ja: でも　それが　何らかの形で　変えられないのなら

key: There is no use in lamenting that which we cannot have in favor of appreciating that which we can.
en: There is no use in lamenting that which we cannot have in favor of appreciating that which we can.
ja: 手に入らないものを　嘆くより　手に入るものに　感謝する方が　いいはずです。

key: SERRA: Aren't we losing sight of the situation here?
en: SERRA: Aren't we losing sight of the situation here?
ja: セラ: ちょっと　状況を　見失ってない?

key: We're only working together; it's not like we're all about to be a happy little family forever or something.
en: We're only working together; it's not like we're all about to be a happy little family forever or something.
ja: わたくしたちは　ただ　協力してるだけで　これから　みんなで　永遠に　幸せな家族に　なるとか　そういう話じゃ　ないでしょう。

key: GARDEVOIR: That might depend on who you ask~
en: GARDEVOIR: That might depend on who you ask~
ja: サーナイト: それは　誰に　聞くかに　よるかもね~

key: SERRA: And speaking of working together, just what exactly are you all doing up here?
en: SERRA: And speaking of working together, just what exactly are you all doing up here?
ja: セラ: それに　協力と言えば　あなたたち　一体　ここで　何を　してるの?

key: RADOMUS: Parenting.
en: RADOMUS: Parenting.
ja: ラドマス: 親としての務めだよ。

key: LUNA: I have received a summons to this place from my dear friend, Shade.
en: LUNA: I have received a summons to this place from my dear friend, Shade.
ja: ルナ: 大切な友人の　シェイドから　この場所への　招集を　受けたのです。

key: Of course, I simply had to answer it.
en: Of course, I simply had to answer it.
ja: もちろん　それに　応えないわけには　いきませんでした。

key: RADOMUS: We were just assessing the viability of the glass pit of death you see before you as an entrance.
en: RADOMUS: We were just assessing the viability of the glass pit of death you see before you as an entrance.
ja: ラドマス: 目の前に　見える　この死のガラスの穴が　入り口として　使えるかどうか　検討していたところだ。

key: SERRA: 'Glass pit of death' sounds like it's about my speed.
en: SERRA: 'Glass pit of death' sounds like it's about my speed.
ja: セラ:「死のガラスの穴」なんて　ちょうど　わたくし好みね。

key: SERRA: That's not even all glass down there.
en: SERRA: That's not even all glass down there.
ja: セラ: あそこ　全部　ガラスってわけでも　ないわね。

key: There's ice too.
en: There's ice too.
ja: 氷も　あるわ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Goodness! You can tell from such a height?
en: GARDEVOIR: Goodness! You can tell from such a height?
ja: サーナイト: あら! こんな高さから　わかるの?

key: SERRA: Oh, please. Who do you think I am?
en: SERRA: Oh, please. Who do you think I am?
ja: セラ: あら　やだ。わたくしを　誰だと　思ってるの?

key: More importantly, it hasn't melted yet.
en: More importantly, it hasn't melted yet.
ja: それより　まだ　溶けてないってことよ。

key: Whatever happened here, happened recently.
en: Whatever happened here, happened recently.
ja: ここで　何が　起きたにせよ　最近の　ことね。

key: GARDEVOIR: The plot thickens! It seems we're even less alone than we thought~
en: GARDEVOIR: The plot thickens! It seems we're even less alone than we thought~
ja: サーナイト: 話が　込み入ってきたわね! 思ってた以上に　わたくしたちだけじゃ　ないみたい~

key: LUNA: If we may be of some service to whomever is responsible for this, let us make haste.
en: LUNA: If we may be of some service to whomever is responsible for this, let us make haste.
ja: ルナ: これを　引き起こした方の　お役に　立てるのでしたら　急ぎましょう。

key: SERRA: I'm sure there must be a less destructively created entrance.
en: SERRA: I'm sure there must be a less destructively created entrance.
ja: セラ: もっと　破壊的じゃない方法で　できた入り口が　きっと　あるはずよ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Then let's scout out and find that!
en: GARDEVOIR: Then let's scout out and find that!
ja: サーナイト: なら　それを　探しに　偵察に　行きましょう!

key: RADOMUS: Right.
en: RADOMUS: Right.
ja: ラドマス: そうだな。

key: RADOMUS: We can do it, or my name isn't Ash Ketchum!
en: RADOMUS: We can do it, or my name isn't Ash Ketchum!
ja: ラドマス: やってみせよう　さもなければ　私の名前は　サトシじゃない!

key: SERRA: Who?
en: SERRA: Who?
ja: セラ: 誰?

key: LUNA: But Master, your name isn't Ash Ketchum!
en: LUNA: But Master, your name isn't Ash Ketchum!
ja: ルナ: でも　マスター　あなたの名前は　サトシじゃ　ありませんが!

key: RADOMUS: And even that can't stop us.
en: RADOMUS: And even that can't stop us.
ja: ラドマス: それすらも　私たちを　止められはしない。

key: Come, let us be off.
en: Come, let us be off.
ja: さあ　行こう。

key: RADOMUS: We found an elevator for open use in the building nearby,
en: RADOMUS: We found an elevator for open use in the building nearby,
ja: ラドマス: 近くの建物で　使用可能な　エレベーターを　見つけてね

key: And so, we made our way through the factory with little difficulty-- I presume thanks, in part, to you, \PN.
en: And so, we made our way through the factory with little difficulty-- I presume thanks, in part, to you, \PN.
ja: それで　工場を　ほとんど　苦労せずに　通り抜けられた――　それは　一部　\PN　君の　おかげだろうと　思っている。

key: And soon we arrived in this room, where we saw...
en: And soon we arrived in this room, where we saw...
ja: そして　すぐに　この部屋に　たどり着き　そこで　見たのは……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
